A newly written exact census now exhausts all 4096 and 262144 representation tuples with full GL(2)xGL(2/3) actions, disjoint orbit covers and exact total mass. originality.rationale: This is a completed positive prior-implication check, not a source-access or evidence-insufficiency failure. Hua's existing general Kac counting formula, explicitly stated as equation (1.1) with all definitions in the HLRV primary paper, supplies precisely A_(2,2) and A_(2,3). Exact rational coefficient extraction over partitions of at most two/three yields log coefficient 189/2 minus the divisor term 7/2 = 91, and coefficient 204 in the coprime case. This is a small routine evaluation of a prior full counting formula, with no new mathematical reduction. The six finite brick witnesses establish standard Schur-root instances and are not claimed unique, extremal or algorithmically new. Consequently the submitted combined table does not supply an original finding under the claim-versus-prior-implication rule. The cuspidal polynomials in Bozec--Schiffmann are different invariants and are NOT misidentified as Kac values.
